law.series: r_t,e_t,u_t ~ N(0,1) independent; x_t = treatment_loading r_t + e_t; w_t ~ Bernoulli(modifier_probability); y_t = slope x_{t-1} + modifier_main w_t + interaction x_{t-1} w_t + noise_sd u_t

planted.pre_trend: adding 1.5 x_t to y_t (the outcome moves with the treatment of the period the pulse is read from) is detected by target.pre_trend; the clean law passes it

oracle.method: Closed form of the stated structural law: the slope of the pulse in x_{t-1} at the modifier w_t is slope + interaction w_t, so the effect marginal over the modifier law is slope + interaction p = 1.5 + 0.8 * 0.4 = 1.82. The unmoderated slope 1.5 is a different number. The refuter contract lists the refuters the temporal conditional study runs at each depth and inference mode (validation-suite design, not derivable); the placebo, control, pre-trend and anticipation checks have the exact null 0 and the stability and prior-sensitivity checks the original value as expectation.
asserted_outputs: marginal_effect (within tolerance.effect; the identified-set ends for a class Bayesian study)
oracle.independence_basis: The generator evaluates the stated slope, interaction and modifier probability in exact rationals; it imports no Antecedent code and no statistics package. The shared object is the stated law.
oracle.historical_exposure: Written for this fixture from the stated law and the declared inputs; no product implementation source was consulted to obtain the values.

reference_review.scope: The marginal conditional effect of a lagged treatment on an outcome over a binary modifier, and the refuter contract of the temporal conditional study.
reference_review.independence_basis: The generator evaluates the stated slope, interaction and modifier probability in exact rationals; it imports no Antecedent code and no statistics package. The shared object is the stated law.
reference_review.historical_exposure: Written for this fixture from the stated law and the declared inputs; no product implementation source was consulted to obtain the values.
reference_review.redistribution: Repository-authored MIT OR Apache-2.0 generator and deterministic inputs. Python standard library only, in an isolated locked script environment, outside the product and ordinary CI; no upstream source is stored.
reference_review.limitations: Law-level truth for a simulated series; the finite series weights the modifier by its sample mean, and sampling error is covered by the stated tolerance. The refuter contract and tolerance bands are validation-suite design choices asserted by the executing tests. The circular-block bootstrap stability is refused for a conditional effect (the interaction design reads no sampling weights). No coverage or calibration claim.
